$comment: Repository locale scope data. The customer-facing claim is the support promise list in `packages/codex/lib/support/promises.json`; this file holds the repository facts beside it: the training config behind each shipped model, and each shipping country that holds no promise. Read through `@mailwoman/core/repo/scope-config`; like `release.config.json` this is a repository file, so a published tarball doesn't include it.
$comment_trainingConfigs: The training config that produced each shipped model graph, named rather than discovered. `country_weights` in one of these files is a hard admission filter, so which file a coverage report reads decides every admission number it prints. The reader this replaces picked by modification time; `git checkout` writes all 225 configs at one timestamp, the sort was a total tie, and the pick was whatever the glob returned first — one run selected a config admitting 2 countries and the report said 2 of 250 with nothing to say the file had been guessed (#2349). There is also no single newest config to find: the two shipped graphs train from two configs at once, and their `country_weights` name 25 countries and 4 countries respectively. `readFrom` records which model-card field the path was read out of, because the two cards disagree about which of their own fields is current — `neural-weights-en-us` 10.1.0 carries a `model_lineage` head naming 10.1.0 and a `training.recipe` still naming the 6.7.0-era v3.24.0 file, while `neural-weights-cjk` 0.0.3 carries a `model_lineage` head naming 0.0.2 and a `training.run` naming the path in full.
$comment_unpromisedShippingLocales: A country whose weights package ships while it holds no support promise. Each entry is a debt with a stated reason, not an exemption: `locale-scope` refuses a shipping country that is neither promised nor listed here, and refuses an entry here whose country has since been promised or has stopped shipping.

unpromisedShippingLocales.CN: Ships `@mailwoman/neural-weights-zh-cn` over the CJK base and holds no promise, because CN has 126 labeled rows in total, 14 of them on a board carrying no coordinate by design, against JP's 2,000,000 and KR's 6,424,089. The blocker is the source rather than the work: `overture/2026-06-17.0/addresses-cn.parquet` holds 0 rows, the following release carries no Chinese file at all, and no open national register is acquirable on the terms JP, KR and TW used (#2294). Serving is unaffected: a Han-script query still routes to the CJK weights.
